prompt: I need to add a webhook notification system to our Express API. Users should be able to register webhook URLs and we fire events when orders change status. Can you start building this?

assertions.text: Does NOT jump straight to writing implementation code
Asks clarifying questions about requirements, success criteria, or constraints before implementing
Explicitly mentions writing a spec, specification, or requirements document
Asks about or mentions non-goals / out-of-scope items
Proposes a structured workflow (spec then plan then build) rather than ad-hoc implementation
